setup.database: PostgreSQL 17.11 on x86_64-pc-linux-musl, compiled by gcc (Alpine 15.2.0) 15.2.0, 64-bit
setup.execution: Local Node process and PostgreSQL Docker on same host. Identical freshly imported seed-42 workloads; queue wait excluded. Modes rotated across trials; no forced cold caches or GC. Existing evidence retained.
setup.latencyDefinition: p50/p95/p99 are wall-clock persistence transaction batch latencies (100 vs 1000 effects), NOT individual payment/request latency. Total run median/min/max are separate.
setup.memoryDefinition: RSS sampled every 25ms; Node process only including fixtures and retained allocations; excludes PostgreSQL/Docker; may miss brief peaks.
